limits: Single physical host, single-worker bounded HTTP subset, loopback; not internet capacity
Host-Python control isolates some VM cost, not all implementation/runtime/OS differences
Guest is QEMU/HVF Linux with user-mode network forwarding; RF2 launches backend, not a new hypervisor
HTTP latency includes socket/client overhead; no compiler-wide/energy/token/transistor claims
Malformed probes are a bounded subset, not complete HTTP conformance or security proof
